item.title: Phonebank for Randy Villegas! — Sun Sep 6, 1:00 PM — Virtual event
item.description:
Join the Villegas for Congress team for our Sunday phonebanks. We'll be calling voters in District 22 to earn their votes for the November 3rd election. Each phone bank will begin with a training on how to use our phonebanking system and to review our script. If you have never phonebanked before that’s okay, we'll make sure you’re comfortable with everything before we start calling. Please join us and bring a friend!
Source: Indivisible Yolo (Mobilize)

item.title: International Folk Dancing — Sun Sep 6, 7:00 PM — Davis Community Church
item.description:
Connect with other cultures, while connecting to other people Sunday nights 7p-9:30p first time free all levels welcome Community Church Fireside Room at 412 C Street, Davis (Fireside Room. Entrance on C-St. near 4th.)
Visit http://davisfolkdancers.org/ to check for our current meeting location, which changes periodically.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Davis Death Cafe — Mon Sep 7, 10:00 AM — Online via Zoom
item.description:
The Monday, Sept 7 meeting will be held on Zoom First Mondays of Every Month 10-11:15am Email Judy Ng at playfold@gmail.com for Zoom login information. We gather to increase awareness of death with the hope of helping people make the most of life. There is no agenda or lecture, just open, engaging conversation in a relaxed and supportive setting. Complimentary tea and refreshments provided. Meets every first Monday of the month.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Davis Makerspace & Clothing Repair Cafe — Mon Sep 7, 6:00 PM — Mary L. Stephens Davis Branch Library
item.description:
Davis Makerspace is a community workspace for makers and builders, designers and inventors. A small assortment of tools will be available for use and staff or volunteers will be on hand to provide some assistance. Supervised children are welcome. Participants must provide a signed liability waiver (available on site). Mondays & Tuesdays, 6p—8p; Thursdays, 9:30a—11:30a.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Intermediate Watercolor with Misuk Goltz — Tue Sep 8, 10:00 AM — Pence Gallery
item.description:
Intermediate Watercolor with Misuk Goltz Tuesdays, 10 AM – 12 PM | September 1, 8, 15, 22, 29 $170 Members, $190 Non-Members (Materials not included) This 5-week workshop with Misuk Goltz will focus on using your brushes to their full potential and practicing diverse hand motions to achieve painterly, expressive watercolor paintings. Students will learn how to distribute different values to create balanced and sophisticated artwork while painting various subjects. Please note that this class is intended for participants who have previous experience with watercolor techniques and color blending. The use of high-quality watercolor materials is strongly recommended to achieve the best results. Register here: https://pencegallery.org/education/programs/workshops-and-classes/ Any questions? Email pencegallery@gmail.com.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Mac Computer Group for Seniors — Tue Sep 8, 5:00 PM — Davis Senior Center
item.description:
Mac Users Group2nd Tuesday of month 5 p.m.No charge The Mac Users discussion group can assist you with learning about the latest technology and gaining advice from others in the community.

item.title: Knitting & Crochet Circle — Tue Sep 8, 5:30 PM — Mary L. Stephens Davis Branch Library
item.description:
Do you enjoy knitting and crocheting? If so, join us on Tuesdays, from 5:30 pm-7 pm. Bring a project to work on and visit with your neighbors. No reservation required. Sponsored by the Friends of the Davis Public Library. Connect with us on Facebook at www.facebook.com/yolocountylibrary.org.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Sthira (Effort) & Sukha (Ease) Yoga — Tue Sep 8, 5:30 PM — Davis Shambhala Meditation Center
item.description:
Sthira (Effort) & Sukha (Ease) Yoga Davis Shambhala Meditation Center Tuesdays, 5:30—6:30 PM, $15
This yoga practice with Beth focuses on alignment, strength & length, balance, effort & ease, and movement with breath.

item.title: UMOJA Mixer for Educators and Professionals — Tue Sep 15, 5:30 PM — Yolo County Office of Education
item.description:
The Yolo County Umoja Workgroup invites educators and professionals in the Black community to join us for an evening of connection, community, and celebration on September 15th in Woodland. Join Umoja Yolo County for an evening of community, connection, and celebration. We’ll catch up with old friends, make new connections, celebrate the talent in Yolo County, and discuss countywide initiatives to help families prepare students for college. We’ll also recognize the 2026 Kwanzaa honorees! Light refreshments will be served. 📅 September 15 | 🕠 5:30–7:30 p.m. 📍 Yolo County Office of Education, 1280 Santa Anita Court, Woodland, CA 95776 RSVP: https://forms.gle/B51Mxwm9mrbLSe9XA
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: Free Yoga Practice — Thu Sep 24, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community 🌀 **Move with intention. Connect with your body. Celebrate community.**
Join us every **Thursday at 6 PM** for an embodied yoga practice designed to help you release tension, ground yourself, and cultivate presence. This is a trauma-informed, all-levels class, no prior yoga experience needed. Expect a Hatha-Vinyasa flow, breathwork, and a space to listen to your body’s wisdom.
🌿 **Every last Thursday of the month, stay after class for a community potluck dinner!**
📍 **Location**: 727 T St. Sacramento CA 95811 ✨ **All our events are free. Donations are welcome.** 📩 **Questions? Reach out at** embody.iama@gmail.com 🔗 **Follow us on Instagram:** [@embody.iama](https://www.instagram.com/embody.iama)
Source: Meetup: Mindful Embodied Spirituality

item.title: Phonebank for Randy Villegas! — Sun Oct 11, 1:00 PM — Virtual event
item.description:
Join the Villegas for Congress team for our Sunday phonebanks. We'll be calling voters in District 22 to earn their votes for the November 3rd election. Each phone bank will begin with a training on how to use our phonebanking system and to review our script. If you have never phonebanked before that’s okay, we'll make sure you’re comfortable with everything before we start calling. Please join us and bring a friend!
Source: Indivisible Yolo (Mobilize)

item.title: Phonebank for Randy Villegas en Español — Wed Oct 14, 5:30 PM — Virtual event
item.description:
Únete al equipo de campaña de Villegas para el Congreso en nuestras sesiones de llamadas a votantes de los miércoles a las 5:30-7:30 pm. Llamamos a los votantes del Distrito 22 para ganar su apoyo para las elecciones del 3 de noviembre. Cada sesión comenzará con un breve entrenamiento sobre el uso de nuestro sistema de llamadas y para revisar del guion. No te preocupes si nunca has hecho esto antes; nos aseguraremos de que te sientas cómodo con todo el proceso antes de empezar a llamar. ¡Acompáñ
